name: reconcile-path-lists
title: Reconcile the ignore, skip-list, and not-stored path lists
description: The three lists that track machine-local Pi paths (.gitignore, scripts/sync.sh's skip-list, README.md's not-stored table) have drifted apart: cache/ is ignored but not reported, trust.json and agent-memory/ are reported but not ignored. Reconcile them and add a doctor.sh check that stops the next drift. Found during the check pass of 09-13-stale-paths-and-lists.
creator: tan
notes: Child of 09-13-repair-harness-drift, 3rd of 3. Invariant enforced: sync.sh's reported-skipped list must be a subset of .gitignore, checked by doctor.sh via git check-ignore. Exact-string matching is required because check-ignore treats a directory pattern's trailing slash as significant (pi-agent/sessions is NOT ignored, pi-agent/sessions/ IS), so PI_NOT_SYNCED is stored in canonical slash-form and doctor.sh validates the exact string. The reverse direction (.gitignore-only patterns) is undetectable by design and harmless.
